# First Industrial Realty Trust Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


**Oct 21, 2026**


- *Cash Rental Rates on New and Renewal Leasing Increased 52% in 3Q26*
- *Cash Same Store NOI Growth of 5.6% in 3Q26*
- *Acquired 100% Leased 764,000 SF Building in Central Pennsylvania for $120 Million in 3Q26*
- *Signed Remaining 32,000 SF at First Park Miami Building 12 in South Florida in 3Q26*
- *2026 FFO Guidance Increased $0.01 at the Midpoint*
- *2026 Cash Same Store NOI Growth Guidance Increased 75 Basis Points at the Midpoint to 6.5%*


First Industrial Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: FR), a leading fully integrated owner, operator and developer of logistics real estate, today announced results for the third quarter of 2026. First Industrial's diluted net income available to common stockholders per share (EPS) was $0.44 in the third quarter, compared to $0.49 a year ago and third quarter funds from operations (FFO) was $0.81 per share/unit on a diluted basis, compared to $0.76 per share/unit a year ago.


“Industrial real estate market fundamentals continued to improve in the third quarter, with strong net absorption reflecting the breadth of tenant demand in the marketplace,” said Peter E. Baccile, First Industrial's president and chief executive officer. “We experienced a strong pace of early renewals from our tenants for our 2027 expirations and we are excited about our levels of overall prospect activity.”


**Portfolio Performance**


- In service occupancy was 94.1% at the end of the third quarter of 2026, compared to 94.9% at the end of the second quarter of 2026, and 94.0% at the end of the third quarter of 2025.
- In the third quarter, cash rental rates on commenced new and renewal leases increased 52% and increased 76% on a straight-line basis.
- The Company has achieved a cash rental rate increase of approximately 38% on leases signed to date commencing in 2026 reflecting 94% of 2026 expirations by square footage.
- The Company has achieved a cash rental rate increase of approximately 16% on leases signed to date commencing in 2027 reflecting 45% of 2027 expirations by square footage.
- In the third quarter, cash basis same store net operating income before termination fees (“SS NOI”) increased 5.6%, primarily reflecting increases in rental rates on new and renewal leasing and contractual rent escalations, partially offset by lower average occupancy.


**Development Leasing Highlights**


****


During the third quarter, the Company:


- Leased the remaining 32,000 square feet of its 136,000 square-foot First Park Miami Building 12 in South Florida; commenced in the third quarter.


**Investment Highlights**


During the third quarter, the Company:


- Acquired a fully leased 764,000 square-foot building in Central Pennsylvania for $120 million.
- Acquired a 32-acre land site in Dallas for $13 million for a two-building project developable to 390,000 square feet.


**Outlook for 2026**


“We increased our guidance by $0.01 at the midpoint based on our third quarter performance and outlook. As always, our team is laser-focused on leasing and serving our current and new customers to drive future cash flow growth,” said Mr. Baccile.


The following assumptions were used for guidance:


- In service occupancy at year-end fourth quarter of 94.5% to 96.5%. This implies a full-year quarter-end average in service occupancy of 94.5% to 95.0%, an increase of 25 basis points at the midpoint. The guidance assumes 650,000 square feet of additional development leasing in December 2026.
- Fourth quarter SS NOI growth on a cash basis before termination fees of 4.0% to 6.0%. This implies SS NOI growth for the full year 2026 of 6.25% to 6.75%, an increase of 75 basis points at the midpoint.
- Includes the incremental costs expected in 2026 related to the Company’s completed and under construction developments as of September 30, 2026. In total, the Company expects to capitalize $0.08 per share of interest in 2026.
- General and administrative expense of $42.0 million to $43.0 million. This range excludes $5.6 million of costs related to a contested proxy campaign recognized in the first quarter.
- Guidance does not include the impact of any future investments, property sales, debt repurchases prior to maturity, debt issuances, equity issuances, or stock repurchases post the date of this press release.


**Conference Call**


First Industrial will host its quarterly conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. CDT (11:00 a.m. EDT). The conference call may be accessed by dialing (833) 890-3273, passcode “First Industrial”. The conference call will also be webcast live on the Investors page of the Company’s website at www.firstindustrial.com. The replay will also be available on the website.


The Company’s third quarter 2026 supplemental information can be viewed at www.firstindustrial.com under the “Investors” tab.


**FFO Definition**


First Industrial calculates FFO to be equal to net income available to common stockholders, unitholders and participating securities, plus depreciation and other amortization of real estate, plus impairment of real estate, minus gain (or plus loss) on sale of real estate, adjusted for any associated income tax provisions or benefits. Similar adjustments are made for our share of net income from an unconsolidated joint venture. This calculation methodology is in accordance with the NAREIT definition of FFO.


**About First Industrial Realty Trust, Inc.**


First Industrial Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: FR) is a leading U.S.-only owner, operator, developer and acquirer of logistics properties. Through our fully integrated operating and investing platform, we provide high quality facilities and industry-leading customer service to multinational corporations and regional firms that are essential for their supply chains. In total, we own and have under development approximately 72.9 million square feet of industrial space concentrated in 15 target MSAs as of September 30, 2026. For more information, please visit us at www.firstindustrial.com.
